events.title: Build with AI 3.0 – GDG Brisbane
events.description: GDG Brisbane presents an evening of practical deep dives into Generative AI and Data Engineering with industry leaders from companies like Atlassian. The evening features talks on LLM evaluation and lessons learned, followed by hands-on workshops on serverless agents and AI-powered data mapping using Gemini and Google Cloud, with networking and food throughout.

events.title: Olafur Eliasson: Presence
events.description: Immersive Brisbane-exclusive exhibition of Icelandic-Danish artist Olafur Eliasson's work across three decades, featuring multi-sensory installations with water, light and temperature — including Riverbed (a rocky landscape with running water) and The Cubic Structural Evolution Project (an all-white Lego city perpetually rebuilt).

events.title: Circa – Swan Lake
events.description: Circa's exuberant, acrobatic take on Swan Lake combines the classic ballet with The Ugly Duckling, featuring a burlesque-style black swan, waddling human ducks, and Circa's signature circus arts and live music. A reinvention of the world's most romantic ballet by one of Brisbane's most inventive theatre companies.

events.title: Anywhere Festival 2026
events.datetime: All week (1–31 May, select shows this week)
events.location: Across Brisbane (New Farm, West End, Mt Coot-tha, Fortitude Valley, and more)
events.description: Brisbane's 16th annual experimental theatre festival transforms unconventional spaces — strip clubs, substations, warehouses, galleries, wine cellars, laneways, botanic gardens, planetariums — into theatre venues. Nearly 300 performances of fringe, immersive and experimental work across the city.

events.title: Platform 2026 Artist Talks
events.location: Institute of Modern Art (IMA), Fortitude Valley
events.description: The IMA's Platform 2026 Artist Talks feature three Queensland-emerging artists—Dean Ansell, Spencer Harvie, and Seren Wagstaff—discussing their ambitious new works in conversation. Spencer Harvie explores AI-generated imagery and online subcultures through surreal cartoon logic, creating thought-provoking dialogue about contemporary art and digital culture.

events.title: Genesis Owusu
events.description: One of Australia's most exciting and genre-defying artists brings a high-energy, experimental live performance. Genesis Owusu blends hip-hop, electronic, and avant-garde elements with sharp lyricism and innovative production—a must-see for adventurous music fans.

events.title: Redlands Coast AdventureFest
events.location: Redlands Coast (various locations, ~45 min from Brisbane CBD)
events.description: A free, community-led outdoor adventure festival in its second year featuring 100+ activities including adrenaline sports, hands-on workshops, kids' activities, interactive displays and nature experiences. Run by Ranger Stacey, this is a genuinely nature-focused event attracting adventurous, outdoorsy people.

events.title: SLQ: Underwater Soundscape Composition Workshop
events.location: State Library of Queensland (The Edge), South Brisbane
events.description: Hands-on workshop led by sound artist and researcher Dr Leah Barclay exploring underwater listening and soundscape composition. Participants discover the art and science of listening to hidden aquatic ecosystems and create original soundscape compositions — a rare intersection of art, science, and environmental thinking.

events.title: GOMA Friday Nights — Olafur Eliasson: Presence
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.description: Extended gallery hours with multi-sensory art by Olafur Eliasson, vinyl listening bar with Brisbane DJs, live performances, and drinks/food. A social, creative evening merging art, music and connection in an intimate cultural setting.

events.title: Make A Scene – Queensland Museum Kurilpa
events.description: Free exhibition celebrating 35 years since the decriminalisation of homosexuality in Queensland, showcasing iconic 90s Australian queer culture, underground nightclub fashion, dance party aesthetics, and personal stories from the LGBTQIA+ community. Features over 100 pieces from Brisbane-based labels and fearless self-expressions.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival – Claire Hooper & Pete Helliar
events.description: Brisbane Comedy Festival's 17th edition runs through May with performances at Brisbane Powerhouse, The Tivoli, Fortitude Music Hall and Princess Theatre. This week: Claire Hooper performing 'fun show xx' (Brisbane Powerhouse 14–17 May) and Pete Helliar recounting his viral ISIS joke incident (Princess Theatre 16–17 May).

events.title: Endless Swarm — Body Hammering Australia 2026 (Brisbane)
events.description: Scotland's powerviolence act Endless Swarm makes their first Southern Hemisphere descent at BackDock Arts—a raw, sweaty underground gig at an authentic DIY arts space. Forged in Edinburgh's underground scene and sharpened across Europe, Japan, and the USA; deeply subcultural and unpolished.

events.title: Platform 2026 Exhibition — Dean Ansell, Spencer Harvie & Seren Wagstaff
events.location: Institute of Modern Art (IMA), Fortitude Valley
events.description: IMA's annual Queensland-emerging-artist exhibition funding three artists to create ambitious new projects. Spencer Harvie presents dark, surreal explorations of online and fan subcultures through AI-generated and imagined imagery; a richly thought-provoking exhibition from Brisbane's most credible contemporary art institution.

events.title: Weaving is Healing — Basketry Workshop
events.description: A hands-on, immersive creative workshop using Figure 8 coil weave technique (with African and European roots) held in Mt Coot-tha's beautiful gardens. Participants weave a small basketling in a ceremony-style sharing and healing circle—grounded, community-oriented, and set in nature.

events.title: National Theatre Live: All My Sons
events.location: Palace Cinemas James St, Fortitude Valley
events.description: Acclaimed five-star production of Arthur Miller's *All My Sons* featuring Bryan Cranston and Marianne Jean-Baptiste, directed by Ivo Van Hove. A disturbingly prescient exploration of the American dream, wartime profiteering, and moral compromise—filmed live from London's West End.

events.title: J.I.D — God Does Like World Tour
events.description: Atlanta rapper J.I.D brings intricate, intelligent lyricism and dynamic stage presence to Fortitude Music Hall. Known for precise wordplay, conceptual albums, and collaborations with top hip-hop producers—a genuine hip-hop experience at one of Brisbane's best live music venues.

events.title: QSO Italian Gala
events.description: Queensland Symphony Orchestra under Maestro Umberto Clerici performs Italian masterworks including Rossini's Barber of Seville, Vivaldi's Triple Concerto for violin, cello and accordion, and dramatic works by Puccini and Verdi. Features world-renowned accordionist James Crabb.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival: Jiggle Jiggle (Josh Thomas)
events.description: Headline act from Josh Thomas at Brisbane Comedy Festival 2026. Described as quirky, hilarious and authentic, featuring his new show Jiggle Jiggle. Part of the festival's diverse 300+ event program across four iconic venues.

events.title: QSO Maestro Series: Rachmaninov & Shostakovich (Main Night)
events.description: Main performance of QSO's Maestro Series featuring Rachmaninov's beloved Piano Concerto No. 2 alongside Shostakovich's emotional 5th Symphony and contemporary work by Cathy Milliken. Intimate classical concert attracting thoughtful music lovers.

events.title: Olafur Eliasson: Presence — Exhibition
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.description: Exclusive Brisbane exhibition of major works by contemporary artist Olafur Eliasson. Immersive, multi-sensory experience exploring light, colour, perception and environmental themes through large-scale installations and a meticulously constructed riverbed.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival: Okay, I Believe You (Auslan Comedy)
events.description: Auslan-interpreted comedy show — a rare opportunity for accessible, inclusive stand-up comedy in Brisbane. Strong community atmosphere at an atmospheric independent venue.

events.title: Australian Cinémathèque: Double Take (Film Program)
events.location: Australian Cinémathèque, Gallery of Modern Art, South Brisbane
events.description: Curated international and art house film program at GOMA's dedicated cinema space. Rare opportunity for thoughtful, intellectually engaging film culture in Brisbane during this period.

events.title: 2026 Brisbane Anywhere Festival
events.location: Various unconventional Brisbane locations (backyards, ferries, lighthouses, driveways)
events.cost: $0–$30 (varies by show; many free or low-cost)
events.source: Brisbane City Council / Anywhere Theatre Company
events.description: Month-long fringe theatre and performance festival featuring experimental, immersive, and site-specific shows in unconventional venues across Brisbane. Attracts creative, open-minded audiences and fosters natural conversation in intimate settings. Specific 11–17 May pop-up schedule to be confirmed, but includes theatre, music, storytelling, and performance art.

events.title: Polestar 5 Design & Tech Preview (Daily Talks)
events.location: Polestar Brisbane, 773 Ann Street, Fortitude Valley
events.description: Free drop-in space showcasing the Polestar 5 electric vehicle and discussing design, performance and sustainability. Daily talks at 11:00 AM on the car's engineering and design philosophy; food, drinks and casual networking throughout the week. Saturday 16 May includes DJ, coffee cart and prize giveaways.

events.title: Weaving is Healing Workshop
events.description: Immersive half-day craft workshop in a ceremony-style healing circle at Mt Coot-tha Botanic Gardens. Learn the Figure 8 coil weave technique with roots in African and European traditions while creating a basketling. A reflective, hands-on experience combining slow-making, community ritual and indigenous craft.

events.title: The Yellow Diary – Live in Brisbane
events.description: The Yellow Diary, an acclaimed Indian indie-pop and alternative band known for introspective lyrics and rich layered sound, plays Brisbane as part of their Australia tour. Show followed by exclusive Bollywood Club Night after-party. A worldly, intimate live music experience.

events.title: Endless Swarm – Body Hammering Australia Tour
events.description: Scottish powerviolence band Endless Swarm makes their first Southern Hemisphere tour stop in Brisbane. Known since 2013 as a ferocious live act in the UK and Europe, they deliver blast-driven hardcore with grind-scarred riffs and venomous vocals in short, savage bursts. A raw, underground show at one of Brisbane's most authentic indie/punk venues.

events.title: Precious – Museum of Brisbane
events.description: Free exhibition featuring over 3,000 loaned items from around 30 private collections and collectors — many on display for the first time. A charming, curious assortment of rare, beautiful and intriguing objects from suburban collections: international dolls, ornamental eggs, wind-up toys and more. A celebration of what people treasure.

events.title: HSBC German Film Festival 2026
events.location: Palace Cinemas James St & other Palace venues, Fortitude Valley
events.description: A curated selection of contemporary German cinema direct from major European festivals, plus films from Austria and Switzerland. All screenings at Palace Cinemas this week—an excellent opportunity to explore art-house European cinema in an independent cinema space.

events.title: Alliance Française French Film Festival
events.datetime: 8–27 May (screenings all week; opening night Fri 8 May)
events.location: Palace Cinemas James St, Fortitude Valley
events.description: Two-week French film festival featuring *Colours of Time* (Cédric Klapisch's new dramedy) as opening night. Opening night screening includes French aperitif and light refreshments—run of screenings throughout the fortnight at Palace.

events.title: Brisbane Social Geeks — Philosophy, Board Games & Intellectual Discussion Meetups
events.datetime: Multiple sessions throughout week (check Meetup page)
events.location: New Farm Library area & Roma Street Parklands, Brisbane
events.description: Recurring community group for people interested in expanding social connections and developing mind and body. Sessions include philosophy discussions (e.g. *The Dictator's Handbook*: power, authority, governance), board games, meditations, and yoga in small, conversational settings—authentic intellectual community with mixed-age attendees.

events.title: Brisbane Social and Language Exchange
events.datetime: Multiple dates this week (check Eventbrite for exact sessions)
events.description: Multicultural social mixer designed to help people meet friends from Brisbane and worldwide. Language exchange covering Japanese, French, Chinese, German, Korean, Italian, Spanish—welcoming students, expats, and locals. Conversational, low-pressure, community-oriented.

events.title: Museum of Brisbane — City Walking Tours
events.location: Museum of Brisbane, City Hall, Brisbane CBD
events.description: Regular guided walking tours exploring Brisbane's CBD history, architecture and hidden stories. Recurring community event attracting curious, conversation-loving participants. Bookings essential.

events.title: QSO Maestro Series Preview Concerts
events.description: Two preview performances of the Maestro Series featuring Rachmaninov's Piano Concerto No. 2, Shostakovich's 5th Symphony, and contemporary work by Cathy Milliken. Chance to experience the program before the main Saturday performance.

events.title: GOMA Kids Tour: Presence & Play
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.description: Multi-sensory family tour of Olafur Eliasson: Presence designed for children. Guided through playful art experiences that spark imagination and build connection, plus exclusive exhibition viewing in a crowd-free setting before public opening.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival: Shad & Pete Save the World!
events.description: Late-night raw variety comedy show running throughout the festival. Intimate, irreverent, unpredictable format suited to those seeking experimental comedy in an atmospheric independent venue.

events.title: SLQ: Dearly Departed: Death in Life — Exhibition
events.location: State Library of Queensland (SLQ), South Brisbane
events.description: Thought-provoking exhibition engaging with death, dying, memory and remembrance through tarot symbolism and visual storytelling. Includes hands-on workshop inviting participants to create symbolic artworks using tarot archetypes.

events.title: Queensland Museum Lunchtime Lectures
events.datetime: Thursdays at lunchtime (check for May dates; next confirmed: 28 May)
events.description: Recurring lunchtime lecture series where Queensland Museum staff present research and behind-the-scenes work. Topics include restoration projects and collections history. Casual, community-oriented format ideal for curious lunch-breakers.

events.title: Museum of Brisbane — Permanent & Current Exhibitions
events.location: Museum of Brisbane, City Hall, Brisbane CBD
events.description: Permanent and rotating exhibitions exploring Brisbane's history, culture and identity. Rooftop location in City Hall provides beautiful setting. Recurring walking tours also available Wednesdays and Saturdays.

events.title: Dog Lovers Festival Brisbane 2026
events.description: Queensland's largest dog festival returns to the Showgrounds with hundreds of beautiful dogs across dozens of breeds, meet-and-greets, dog brand shopping, breed showcases and adoption zones. A genuinely community-spirited outdoor event attracting families and animal-loving people who naturally strike up conversations.

events.title: Brisbane Riverside Social Walk
events.description: Recurring weekly social walk along Brisbane Riverside with the Brisbane Riverside Social Walkers community. A relaxed, low-key outdoor meetup attracting curious and active people interested in gentle exercise and conversation.

events.title: Brisbane Boardgamers – Saturday Night
events.description: Long-running Brisbane Boardgamers community meets for an evening of tabletop and strategy games. Very low cost, conversational, and attracts curious, analytical, game-loving people of mixed ages and backgrounds — great for naturally meeting new people.

events.title: Brisbane Social Sport Group – Wednesday & Sunday
events.datetime: Wed 13 May, 7:00 PM; Sun 17 May, 2:00 PM
events.description: Recurring community social sports meetup attracting a friendly, mixed-age crowd interested in casual team games and outdoor activity. Natural conversation starter and great for meeting new people while getting active.

events.title: Brisbane Language Exchange Friday
events.description: Recurring weekly language exchange and cultural meetup in Brisbane. A naturally conversational community attracting internationally-minded, culturally curious people interested in learning languages and making friends. Ideal for striking up conversations before and after.

events.title: Data Science & Analytics Meetup – Brisbane Friday
events.description: Recurring Eventbrite meetup for data, analytics and tech-curious professionals and enthusiasts to connect and discuss ideas. More conversational and community-focused than corporate — good for intellectually engaged people to exchange ideas and network.

events.title: The Drover's Wife – The Opera (World Premiere)
events.description: World premiere of a new opera based on Henry Lawson's iconic Australian short story 'The Drover's Wife', performed at QPAC's stunning Glasshouse Theatre. A rare opportunity to witness Brisbane as the birthplace of a major new operatic work.

events.title: The Sapphires
events.description: The Sapphires tells the joyful, moving and musically rich story of four Aboriginal women who sang soul music for American troops in Vietnam. A beloved musical theatre work celebrating friendship, music and cultural resilience.

events.title: Jean Barth — 'Screen Tests'
events.datetime: 2–30 May (open during gallery hours; all week)
events.description: Jean Barth's *Screen Tests* exhibition at one of Brisbane's most respected contemporary art galleries in West End. Milani Gallery regularly showcases significant Australian artists in a professional, intellectually engaged space.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival — Geraldine Hickey: A Weight Off My Chest
events.description: Beloved Australian stand-up comedian Geraldine Hickey performs *A Weight Off My Chest* across four nights at the Princess Theatre—an intimate theatre setting with a seasoned, accomplished comedic voice.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival — Ray O'Leary: I Can See O'Leary Now The Ray Has Gone
events.description: New Zealand comedian Ray O'Leary brings his show to the Princess Theatre for three nights. Few tickets remaining, so availability is limited.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival — Pete Helliar: An International Kerfuffle
events.description: High-profile Australian comedian Pete Helliar performs *An International Kerfuffle* across two nights at the Princess Theatre—a fun, accessible weekend comedy option at an intimate venue.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival: Bron Lewis
events.location: Brisbane Powerhouse – Underground Theatre, New Farm
events.description: Stand-up comedy show by Bron Lewis, a Brisbane-based performer exploring the chaos of motherhood, three kids, and a new puppy. Intimate show in the Underground Theatre, one of Brisbane's most atmospheric comedy venues.

events.title: Suitcase Rummage - Brisbane/Meanjin Market
events.location: Reddacliffe Place (top of Queen Street Mall), Brisbane City
events.description: A curated vintage and secondhand market featuring independent vendors selling clothing, collectibles, and bric-a-brac at Brisbane Square. Popular community event attracting browsers, collectors, and creative types looking for unique finds.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival — Jason Leong
events.source: Fortitude Music Hall / Brisbane Comedy Festival
events.description: Stand-up comedian Jason Leong performs at Fortitude Music Hall as part of the Brisbane Comedy Festival program.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival — VHS
events.location: Brisbane Powerhouse, Graffiti Room, New Farm
events.description: *VHS* plays the intimate Graffiti Room at Brisbane Powerhouse—one of the Brisbane Comedy Festival's designated stages in the heritage-listed Powerhouse building on the Turbine level. Atmospheric, small-venue comedy-theatre setting.

events.title: Audrey Hobert — The Staircase To Stardom Tour
events.description: Audrey Hobert performs *The Staircase To Stardom Tour* at Fortitude Music Hall.
